text.p: These are significant stories in the Nigerian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- United States and British embassies in Nigeria embarrass the government by making Nigerians wait in long lines, and at odd times, if they want to apply for visas.
- The huge, and unfinished, Ajaokuta steel plant is the victim of massive theft of equipment.
- In the next few weeks the government is likely to publish a white paper which will provide for an extensive reorganisation of Nigeria's aviation industry.
- Over a three-month period last year, thieves carted away 45 km (28 miles) of electrical conductors, as well as insulators and transformer parts, from a power line in southern Oyo state.
- About forty houses were ruined when a petrol tanker caught fire in a busy district of southeastern Port Harcourt.
